source.note: Corrected base pin: the first pass was built on 23eaaea7b8 (1,758 added keys); this branch is rebuilt on 5d97575ac4 per the coordinator's correction, with the 38 keys that head pruned removed and the 11 keys it changed or added translated (link_actions.open/quote, image_gen_card.stop/retry/restart, session_cost.basis_billed/included/estimated/subagents_amount, session_context.context, agent_reasoning.reasoning, ui.chat.canvas_preview).

scope.note: All 1,733 keys the batch adds are translated. Russian already carried three of the fifteen namespaces, so their 30 pre-existing English keys keep their audited values (ui.chat 8, ui.chat.header 10, ui.chat.asks 12). ui.chat.canonical and ui.chat.run_details existed only in English: their 32 pre-existing keys are translated here as well, because a shipped locale file must cover its whole namespace. The remaining twelve namespaces are created complete. Total: 1,795 Russian keys across 15 namespaces. No key outside the English source exists.

translator_calls.register: formal «вы», lowercase mid-sentence; infinitive action labels; sentence case; «ёлочки» in prose; em dash with spaces; no typographic spacing before punctuation

chosen_terms.aside: отдельный вопрос (matches the existing «Спросить отдельно» composer copy)
chosen_terms.to-do: задача (job stays «задание», per the ru style guide)
chosen_terms.credential (single stored value): секрет; the store stays «хранилище учётных данных»
chosen_terms.prompt suggestions: imperative forms, because these strings are the user's own words to the agent, not product copy addressed to the user

translator_calls.plurals: every Russian plural carries one/few/many/other; exact =N arms from the English source are preserved; select arms mirror English exactly
translator_calls.token_exemptions: 85 language-neutral values (placeholder-and-punctuation formats, DOM ids/routes, CSS custom properties, keyboard chords, literal Windows folder/path names, product names, and Top K/Top P) are declared in scripts/i18n/locale-parity.test.mjs IDENTICAL_OK with per-key reasons
translator_calls.overflow: no value exceeds an annotated maxCells/character budget in the English sidecars. Flagged risk: ui.chat.header.chat_tabs.raw renders «Исходный текст» (14 cells) against English «Raw» (3) in a tab; if the tab strips truncate, the shipped label should shorten to «Текст».
